additionalScopeNotes.qualification: The simplified source timeline is not an assertion of exact invention dates or the current best-performing architecture.
Real microphone response need not exactly reproduce the acoustic pressure shape; the source transduction drawing is idealized.
Amplitude/loudness and frequency/pitch are comparative simplified associations, not exact psychoacoustic laws for all speech.
Sampling discreteness in time is distinguished from amplitude quantization.
The prose calls L a number of frames, but the equation indexes L samples inside one window. The periodic denominator L is valid and is not silently changed to L−1.
Raw complex DFT coefficients are distinguished from magnitude, squared magnitude and dB displays.
The displayed 1127 natural-log mapping is one Mel convention, not every library default.
A filter’s weight vector and its scalar energy response are different despite overloaded m_i notation; numerical floor and scaling are separate implementation choices.
The 5–19 acoustic-to-text sequence ratio is illustrative; finite framing, speech rate and tokenization change it.
Stride-one output length equals input for the width-one example or appropriate padding, not all valid wider kernels.

The printed unflipped kernel sum follows cross-correlation convention. General channel/output-specific weights are suppressed in the compact notation. Subsampling need not remove every skipped-index contribution and does not itself solve alignment.
The illustrated encoder-decoder is not mandatory for all ASR architectures.
Characters are illustrative tokens; tokenization may use subwords. Greedy search is not a globally optimal-sequence guarantee.
The external-language-model scoring example does not establish default Whisper external-LM fusion. |Y|_c is character count, not a free exponent.
The checked frontend uses a Hann window, unlike the generic Hamming teaching pipeline. The two convolutional strides are one then two. Multitask capabilities do not force all outputs simultaneously.

No pretrained ASR inference was executed in this authoring run. The source notebook and slide sentence remain reported output. Static code analysis, numerical checks and module tests are not a reproduction of that transcript. The install route was denied and not retried.
TTS reverses modality direction, not a unique acoustic inverse. LLM-based understanding is an example, and speech-to-speech does not mean every architecture lacks internal text.
